Dear Sir/ Madam,

2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations’’), please be informed that Earnings Conference Call pertaining to Financial

at https://www.aequs.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Earnings-Call-Audio-Q2-FY-27.mp3
